notes: kb/Work PB1275 LANDED (w1014u). cite.py --check 8.4.3.9.3 'may be specified wherever a data item with that description would be valid as a receiving item' OK 6). With the store taxonomy total, a property receives in every statement that stores its description: SET R OF A TO A and SET INNER OF A TO D (Format 5, golden lines 1/4), SET Q OF A TO ADDRESS OF W (Format 7, line 3), SET Q OF A UP BY 2 (Format 10, read-modify-write, line 5), ALLOCATE ... RETURNING Q OF A (line 6), FREE Q OF A (line 7), STRING ... INTO S OF A (receiving only, line 8). A receiving use without a SET accessor is refused under SR4 by name (negative pb1275-set-property-no-set).
